change_policy.patch: code correction found before economic reveal with a new full hash freeze
change_policy.minor: documentation or visualization that cannot alter eligibility or outcomes
change_policy.major: any concept, required sequence, entry, invalidation, target, deadline, outcome or playbook-set change

playbooks.thesis: A locked confirmed 4H HH/HL or LH/LL structure is followed by a same-direction 1H continuation BOS, then the pre-existing 5m displacement/pullback and 1m trigger sequence.

required_sequence.description: A causally locked 4H HH/HL or LH/LL sequence confirms the thesis direction.
A later completed 1H close confirms a same-direction continuation BOS through a previously confirmed structural swing.
The existing direction-aligned 5m impulse proxy establishes the setup clock; displacement semantics are not changed in this experiment.
The existing pullback proxy develops after displacement; FVG/OB location is intentionally deferred to a later experiment.
The existing completed 1m trigger holds after the pullback; trigger semantics are not changed in this experiment.

phase_rules.inactive: No registered structure sequence has started.
phase_rules.forming: The 4H structure or a causal plan is incomplete.
phase_rules.armed: The locked structure, continuation BOS and plan exist while the remaining trigger sequence is incomplete.
phase_rules.waiting_pullback: The structural gates passed and the model waits under the unchanged legacy location/trigger proxy during this single-family experiment.
phase_rules.executable: All five registered steps are causally ordered and the unchanged calibrated executable gate is met.
phase_rules.entered: A risk-approved order filled after the decision clock.
phase_rules.weakening: The frozen thesis remains open while calibrated support weakens.
phase_rules.delivering: The open thesis progresses toward the frozen target.
phase_rules.completed: The registered target is delivered before invalidation and deadline.
phase_rules.invalidated: The frozen structural invalidation is breached, the setup expires, or a terminal contradiction occurs.

invalidation.source: unchanged v2.3 nearest causally confirmed thesis-side swing

targets.source: unchanged v2.3 decision-time unswept external liquidity inventory

playbooks.thesis: A pre-existing visible level is swept, the unchanged 5m impulse proxy displaces in the reversal direction, and a later opposed 1m BOS closes through the pre-sweep short-term structure.

required_sequence.description: A decision-time visible level is swept on the thesis invalidation side.
After the sweep, the unchanged 5m impulse proxy displaces in the thesis direction.
After reverse displacement, a completed 1m close confirms an opposed BOS through the pre-existing protected swing.

phase_rules.forming: A sweep exists but reverse displacement, plan provenance or support is incomplete.
phase_rules.armed: Sweep, reverse displacement and plan exist while opposed micro-BOS is incomplete.
phase_rules.waiting_pullback: The model waits for the registered opposed micro-BOS under the unchanged phase enum.
phase_rules.executable: Sweep, reverse displacement and opposed 1m BOS are causally ordered and the unchanged calibrated gate is met.
phase_rules.entered: A risk-approved reversal order filled after the decision clock.
phase_rules.weakening: The frozen reversal thesis remains open while support weakens.
phase_rules.delivering: Price progresses toward opposing liquidity without rewriting the invalidation.
phase_rules.completed: The registered target is delivered before invalidation and deadline.
phase_rules.invalidated: Price accepts beyond the frozen sweep extreme, the setup expires, or a terminal contradiction occurs.

targets.source: unchanged decision-time unswept opposing liquidity inventory

playbooks.thesis: Unchanged v2.3 failed-auction proxy retained for shadow structure diagnostics; BOS cannot substitute for the not-yet-implemented mature range, value and re-entry primitives.

required_sequence.description: Unchanged v2.3 rejection or sweep candidate.
Unchanged v2.3 completed 1H/5m proxy points back into the prior range.
Unchanged v2.3 1m path proxy; it receives no new trading authority from BOS.

phase_rules.inactive: No qualifying failed-auction proxy is active.
phase_rules.forming: The legacy candidate exists but return-to-value evidence or plan is incomplete.
phase_rules.armed: The legacy failure, plan and support exist while the path proxy is incomplete.
phase_rules.waiting_pullback: The legacy proxy waits for acceptance or path trigger.
phase_rules.executable: Legacy sequence completion is recorded only for shadow diagnosis during this experiment.
phase_rules.entered: No v3 managed-value artifact is authorized.

invalidation.source: unchanged observed failure or sweep extreme
